articles.title: Amazon, Tesla and SpaceX join OKX–ICE tokenized stock objections as deadline looms
articles.snippet: Objections have reached 56 companies, with nearly 80% of the venture’s initial stock selection opting out.

articles.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview, and a campaign 'built over many months'
articles.snippet: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees and internal systems before exploiting its hot-wallet signing infrastructure through Ethereum's EIP-7702 mechanism.

articles.title: CZ warns of more AI-driven hacks following Binance’s historic $6.3 billion heist
articles.snippet: While investigators found no evidence that AI agents laundered the stolen Binance funds, Zhao stressed that automated tools are lowering the barrier for complex breaches.

articles.title: ETHGas wants to bring Wall Street to public Ethereum with institutional controls
articles.snippet: The proposed service would offer sanctions screening and qualified validators, but current compensation for failed commitments is set at zero.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner Cipher posts $31 million profit as AI pivot begins
articles.snippet: The company's revenue dropped 63% in the third quarter, while a $127 million accounting gain helped turn an operating loss into a reported profit.
